lines.text: You made good money this month. So why is the account empty again? It is not a discipline problem. You just can't see where it goes.
One balance makes every dollar look spendable. CFoh gives every dollar a job the moment it lands.
Six envelopes: operating, your pay, tax, profit, reserve and growth. Set once, applied to the cent.
A ceiling on tools and overhead. It warns you the day you cross it, not at month end.
Pay yourself on purpose. Household first, then the rest.
Watch the result line climb, week by week.
Close the month in ten steps. The report writes itself.
Start your free month today, at abdurrub dot com slash CFoh.
